meta.title: The Last Days
meta.subtitle: ☠️ The world has fallen. What you do now decides how your story ends.
meta.historyEmptyText: Your path will be recorded here as you make choices.

scenes.title: ☠️ Day 1
scenes.narrative:
🚨 Sirens echo through the city.

Emergency broadcasts repeat the same warning: Stay inside.

Outside, chaos has already begun.

🏃 People run through the streets while 🔥 fires spread in the distance.

Something is terribly wrong.

scenes.title: 🔒 Locked In
scenes.narrative:
You lock the doors and shut the blinds.

📺 The TV flickers with reports of an outbreak.

🥫 Supplies are limited, and the city sounds worse every minute.

scenes.title: 🏚️ The Streets
scenes.narrative:
😨 Panic fills the streets.

🚗 Cars sit abandoned. Glass crunches beneath your feet.

Then you see it.

A figure stumbles toward you… moving strangely. 👁️

scenes.title: 📵 No Answer
scenes.narrative:
You call friends and family.

Most lines are dead.

☎️ One finally connects… then cuts to static and screaming.

scenes.title: 🛠️ Preparation
scenes.narrative:
You gather food, water, batteries, and tools.

🎒 You're more prepared now… but nowhere feels truly safe.

scenes.title: 👹 First Encounter
scenes.narrative:
The infected lunges at you.

⚡ You barely fight it off.

Breathing heavily, you realize the truth.

This nightmare is real.

scenes.title: 🏪 Abandoned Store
scenes.narrative:
You slip into a looted store.

Most shelves are empty, but you manage to find a few supplies.

👥 Voices whisper somewhere in the back.

scenes.title: 👥 Survivors
scenes.narrative:
A nervous group of survivors greets you.

🤝 They offer safety, food, and a place to rest.

But trust is hard to come by now.

scenes.title: 🚶 Alone
scenes.narrative:
You choose to survive alone.

🌑 The silence is unsettling.

Every shadow feels dangerous.

scenes.title: 🤝 Traveling Together
scenes.narrative:
You travel with the group through the ruined streets.

📡 They speak of a safe zone beyond the city.

scenes.title: 💨 Narrow Escape
scenes.narrative:
You sprint into a dark alley.

The city noise fades behind you.

Too quiet. 👁️

scenes.title: 🏢 Rooftop
scenes.narrative:
From the rooftop, the city burns below.

🚁 Helicopters pass overhead… but none stop.

scenes.title: 🏠 Safehouse
scenes.narrative:
You find a secure building and barricade the doors.

For now, it feels safe.

But supplies won't last forever. 🥫

scenes.title: 🌄 Edge of the City
scenes.narrative:
You finally reach the edge of the city.

The roads ahead are empty.

Broken… but quieter.

scenes.title: ✅ Safe Zone
scenes.narrative:
You reach a guarded checkpoint.

🩺 Soldiers scan you carefully.

The gates open.

You made it.

scenes.title: 💀 Too Late
scenes.narrative:
You stay inside and wait.

Days pass in silence.

Then one night… something gets in.

scenes.title: 🚁 Rescue
scenes.narrative:
A helicopter spots your signal.

Moments later, you're lifted into the sky.

You survived. ✨

scenes.title: 🪦 Lone Survivor
scenes.narrative:
You survive on your own.

It's harsh. Lonely.

But day by day… you endure.

scenes.title: 🌅 New Beginning
scenes.narrative:
You leave the ruined city behind.

The world is broken.

But you're still alive.

And that means hope.

scenes.title: ⚡ Overwhelmed
scenes.narrative:
You return to the city.

Shapes emerge from the darkness.

There is no escape.
